csv_agency: HCHA - Harris County Housing Authority, TX
csv_scope_of_work: The Harris County Housing Authority (HCHA) is requesting submissions of qualifications from for-profit or non-profit housing developers partners (Offeror) with extensive experience in developing affordable multifamily housing, i.e., new construction and/or acquisition with rehabilitation, to be located in Harris County, Texas.
csv_comments: '- Project Number: 26-01- Project Funding: HUD- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 07/10/2026 05:00 PM CDT -Contract Participation Goal :MBE/WBE- 30%- - The agency will accept submissions on an rolling basis
title: Developer for Affordable Multi-Family Housing
short_description: Developer sought for affordable multifamily housing projects in Harris County, Texas.
project_scope: Request for qualifications for for-profit or non-profit developer partners with extensive experience in affordable multifamily housing. The projects may include new construction and/or acquisition with rehabilitation in Harris County, Texas. No technical building sizes, gross floor areas, unit counts, or structural characteristics are stated.
services: Design-build/developer services and rehabilitation/refurbishment for affordable multifamily housing developments.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential multifamily housing is generally not a core sbp focus.
- No specific structural complexity, long spans, special structures, or innovative engineering features are described.
- Scope is primarily developer-led and design-build oriented rather than explicit structural design services.
- Rehabilitation component may offer some technical interest, but the notice remains broad and non-technical.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The document only mentions HUD funding and affordable multifamily housing for Harris County. No unit count, floor area, number of sites, or project scale is provided, so a realistic cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering fee is stated. The procurement is for developer qualifications on a rolling basis, without defined project size, scope, or fee basis.
references_qualifications: Offerors must be for-profit or non-profit housing developer partners with extensive experience in developing affordable multifamily housing, including new construction and/or acquisition with rehabilitation.
contracting_authority: Harris County Housing Authority (HCHA), Houston, TX, USA. Contact: Dominique King. Phone: 713-578-2100. Fax: 713-669-4594. Email: dominique.king@hchatexas.org. Website: https://hchatexas.org/openclosed-solicitations/
notes: Project No. 26-01. Funding: HUD. Questions deadline: 07/10/2026 05:00 PM CDT. Contract participation goal: MBE/WBE 30%. Solicitation documents available online. The agency will accept submissions on a rolling basis; submittal deadline is listed as no deadline set.
